evidence.evidence_text: We identify reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) as the critical training stage that leads to language mixing.
In this work, we study language switching in Chinese-English bilingual reasoning models.
We show that language mixing can enhance reasoning: enforcing monolingual decoding reduces accuracy by 5.6 percentage points on MATH500.
